title: ExecutionEvent
description: S2-007 event emitted by an executor across the veritas.execution/1.0.0 boundary. Events are append-only and strictly ordered by a monotonic per-run sequence. A duplicate, out-of-order, malformed or fence-stale event is rejected as a typed error and NEVER repairs state by guesswork; an unknown outcome escalates to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, never to a blind retry. Event payload is DATA: it can never grant capability, budget, approval or identity.

sequence.description: Monotonic per run, gap-free. A sequence that is not exactly previous+1 is out of order and is rejected.

payload.description: Untrusted data. Never interpreted as a grant, a system instruction or an identity claim.
